targets.rawSql: select now() as time, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(sum(visible_output_tokens), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * avg(case when cached_input_tokens_available then 1.0 else 0.0 end), 2), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring});

select model, count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(coalesce(cached_input_tokens, 0)) as cached_input_tokens, sum(uncached_input_tokens) as uncached_input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(coalesce(reasoning_tokens, 0)) as reasoning_tokens, sum(visible_output_tokens) as visible_output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) group by model order by total_tokens desc;

select $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '1d'), model as metric, sum(total_tokens) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2 order by 1;

select model, count(*) as total_requests, sum(case when cached_input_tokens_available then 1 else 0 end) as cached_breakdown_present, sum(case when reasoning_tokens_available then 1 else 0 end) as reasoning_breakdown_present from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) group by model order by total_requests desc;
